songs.title: Endless Summer
lyrics: Should have known at the end of summer
The innocence fades and the weak become stronger
Should have known at the end of the summer
The skyline looked like a stained glass window
The city sang such mad crescendo
Four bare feet on a rain soaked street
Why do the bad girls never last
Except for the polaroids i left
You were just some spell i was under

songs.title: Sunset
lyrics: They say it's darkest before the dawn
We've been in this town for far too long
They say it's darkest before the dawn

songs.title: Jason
lyrics: He comes alive in metropolis lights when the musics way too loud
Deep in the night it's easy to hide and he's got it all figured out
White satellites getting lost in his eyes but to him she's just another girl
Roll with the tide like the wind and the sky and he'll only let you down
Because the night will never give you what you want
And if you can't escape it
I hope you find whatever you've been looking for
Where do you go in a town full of ghosts and everybody knows your name
And all the homecoming queens in the small town scenes they'll offer you a place to stay
Some want forever instead of whenever when they're naked in the light
It's a strange little potion but sometimes the motion almost makes you feel alive
And I'm gonna keep on running

songs.title: Synthetic
lyrics: I locked my love into the ground
Hoped it never could be found
I'm still alive but I can't feel
I got stuff inside but it's not real
They say I'm fine but I feel synthetic
I'm just a machine full of moving parts
I got emptiness where I used to have a heart
I'm still breathing but I'm synthetic
Left who I was back there with you
In a body made of plastic and glue
I'm still alive but I can't feel
I got stuff inside but it's not real
They say I'm fine but I feel synthetic
I'm just a machine full of moving parts
I got emptiness where I used to have a heart
I'm still breathing but I'm synthetic

songs.title: The Comeback Kid
lyrics: Like i was a screen door
You’re why I get up again
Cause you know you are are

songs.title: Vampires
lyrics: Strangers in a dark room, laughing at jokes they didn't quite hear
Frosted window panes and cheap champagne a face appears
And anything could happen in these cathedrals we roam
Where shadow people dance and trade their glance and walk home alone
She's staring out the window of the Roosevelt Hotel
Watching midtown empty out and I kiss her farewell
They say we come from nothing and to nothing we'll return
And in between is gravity and bridges left to burn

songs.title: Nighthawks
lyrics: Do i ever cross your mind
Through your window in the sky
When you forget to close the blinds
Do i ever cross your mind
Through your window in the sky
When you forget to close the blinds

songs.title: Memories
lyrics: Everything is clear in the rear view mirror
The coast highway and the golden hour
Everything fits when you tell your story
The blurry portraits in the halls of former lovers
You'll always be a part of me
You gave me a song to sing
We'll know better when we're older
You'll always be a part of me
We'll know better when we're older
All of this was planned when the world was started
The final word was never said
But everything is clear in the rear view mirror
The lights of evening round us shine pink and silver skies
You'll always be a part of me
You gave me a song to sing
We'll know better when we're older
You'll always be a part of me
We'll know better when we're older

songs.title: Comet
lyrics: And if my mind says stop
My heart will know what to do
And if the stars are faded
I'll blow the sun to pieces
And forget the world for a while
Cause we never met at all
Let's go back to where we started
Let me burn through your atmosphere
You see the light in the sky,
Out here where the air is clearer,
Let's go back to where we started
Let me burn through your atmosphere

songs.title: Bend
lyrics: You break like waves on the ocean, on the ocean
And you have to deal with the explosion, though I know that
Everything will always be exactly how it's gonna be
Though I seem to worry every single day
This prodigal turns home again then morning comes and in the end
I see that new sun shining on your face
You seem to flow above the madness like wings on canvas
Is that I hear the notes through the darkness like a promise
